name: flow-vault
description: Invisible credential injection into process.env at runtime. Loaded via node --require. Zero credentials on disk. v0.2: reads .flow/integrations.json (written by flow-cli) and routes per-integration to the configured source adapter (flow-hosted live; aws-secrets-manager live; HashiCorp Vault / Azure Key Vault / GCP Secret Manager planned).
author: Vivek Chaudhary <vivek@kindtree.us>
